title: Library
description: Each key is a file, relative to this library.json. Any file type can be a card. It may belong to a category and lists the lessons that belong to it. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: Optional. The schema is applied automatically to any file named library.json.

$categories.description: Optional look of each category, keyed by the exact category name used on cards. Keeps category settings flat instead of nesting cards inside categories.

$fileTypes.description: Optional settings for every file with a given extension, keyed by extension such as .cs or .md. A preview here applies to all lessons and cards of that type unless a category, card or lesson sets its own.

color.description: Color of the row in the Library view. A name, or any VS Code theme color id such as charts.red.

oneOf.description: A theme color id, for example charts.red or errorForeground.

card.description: A card, any file next to library.json: where it sits and which lessons belong to it.

category.description: Cards with the same category are shown together under a folder with this name.

order.description: Position among the cards in the same category. Lower comes first. Cards without an order go after those with one, sorted by name.

title.description: Shown next to the card name in the Library view.

description.description: One or two sentences about the card. Shown next to the name, after the title.

icon.description: Icon shown for this card in the Library view: an icon id from the active icon theme, or a codicon like $(book). Completion lists the theme's icons.

lessons.description: The files that belong to this card.

lesson.description: A file that belongs to the card, plus optional order and metadata.

order.description: Position under the card. Lower comes first. Lessons without an order go after those with one, sorted by name.

title.description: Shown next to the file name in the Library view.

description.description: One or two sentences about what the file covers. Shown next to the file name, after the title.

tags.description: Free-form labels, for example topics or the day it was written.

date.description: The day this file was written, as YYYY-MM-DD.

category.description: How a category folder looks in the Library view.

icon.description: Icon for the category folder: an icon id from the active icon theme, or a codicon like $(folder-library). Completion lists the theme's icons.

order.description: Position among categories. Lower comes first. Categories without an order go after those with one, sorted by name.

description.description: Shown next to the category name.

previewAction.description: A quick action link at the bottom of the hover.

preview.description: What the hover shows. true shows everything, false hides the hover. An object configures the parts: anything left out is inherited from the card, then the category, then the file type.

summary.description: The block at the top with the name, title, category, tags and date.

code.description: The excerpt with the first lines of the file.

actions.description: Which quick action links to show. An empty list hides them all.

fileType.description: Settings shared by every file with this extension.

defaultSnippets.label: Hide code, keep Run, Open and Edit Details

rowPart.description: A piece of information shown next to the row label.

dateFormat.description: How a lesson date is written in the row. 'smart' shows Today, Yesterday, the weekday for the last week, then the full date. Otherwise a pattern with the tokens YYYY, YY, MMMM, MMM, MM, M, DD, D, dddd, ddd, for example MM/DD or MMM D, YYYY.

row.description: How the row looks in the Library view. Anything left out is inherited from the card, then the category, then the file type.

label.description: What the row is called: the file name, or the title when one is set.

parts.description: What shows next to the label, in this order. A part that equals the label is skipped.

defaultSnippets.label: Title with the date next to it
